decisions.reason: The monthly target of 180 approved clips is separately introduced by the same message and is not changed by reducing the approval-trial batch to eight clips.

The existing source-selection scope names the earlier six-clip trial, but the source does not establish whether those source rules carry over to the new eight-clip trial or whether the linked offer defines new sources.
Changing the assigned trial quantity to eight does not alter the requirement to select strong or substantive moments.
The new batch quantity and general request for perfect clips do not modify the established clean visual-editing standard.
The source changes the trial batch size but does not change the hook-selection criterion.
The source contains no decision changing or withdrawing the required caption color treatment.
The revised trial quantity does not affect the historical observation that the submitted font selection worked well.
The source does not change the established 20-to-120-second duration range.
Reducing the assigned batch to eight clips does not alter the requirement that each clip deliver a complete message or goal.
